analysis: The only change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is one documentation table row added at head line 1750. It lists DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS as environment variables forwarded to the launchd daemon, citing prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift. The supplied units are base text only, so the changed line is not visible. I examined the surrounding base text (the GLM qualification section, cache section, start/stop/logout/autopilot docs) and the patch excerpt. The change touches no code, authentication, attestation, encryption or authorization path, and it neither changes nor documents any control related to T-041, TB-011 or T-053. The edit documents that two prefill and step tuning knobs are passed from the shell into launchd. The Swift implementation, its bounds validation, and whether the passthrough exists as documented are outside the supplied evidence. The operator controls the provider environment, which is already adversarial under TB-003, and these knobs affect availability and performance only, not confidentiality. The GLM section separately says prefill chunks are at most 2,048 tokens; if the passthrough bypasses that clamp it would be a code question, not a documentation finding. The recommended follow-up is to confirm in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift that the forwarded values are clamped and cannot weaken admission limits (T-010 and T-029 availability class). No finding is raised, since the implementation is not in evidence.
